# statuspage_metrics_provider (Resource)

Manages a Statuspage metrics provider.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "statuspage_metrics_provider" "datadog" {
  page_id         = "abc123def456"
  type            = "Datadog"
  api_key         = "your-datadog-api-key"
  application_key = "your-datadog-app-key"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `page_id` (String)
- `type` (String) One of: Pingdom, NewRelic, Datadog, Self, Librato, CalabashCustom.

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive)
- `api_token` (String, Sensitive)
- `application_key` (String, Sensitive)
- `email` (String, Sensitive)
- `metric_base_uri` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
